mapper.insert: insert into orders ( number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, phone, address, consignee, delivery_status, delivery_time, tableware_number, tableware_status ) values ( #{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus} )
mapper.update: update orders set status = 6,cancel_time = #{cancelTime},cancel_reason = '订单超时未支付，自动取消' where status = 1 and pay_status = 0 and order_time < #{deadline}
mapper.select: select * from orders where user_id = #{userId} order by order_time desc

select * from orders
and number like concat('%', #{number}, '%')
and phone like concat('%', #{phone}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by order_time desc
mapper.update: update orders set status = 3 where id = #{id} and status = 2
update orders set status = 6, cancel_time = #{cancelTime}, cancel_reason = '商家取消订单' where id = #{id} and status in (2, 3)
update orders set status = #{status}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, checkout_time = #{checkoutTime} where id = #{id} and status = 1 and pay_status = 0
